name: clubdmx_code
description: Light operation with a web interface, suitable for various DMX hardware and ethernet protocols.

paragraphs: LIGHT OPERATION with a Web interface, suitable for various DMX hardware and ethernet protocols. For a demo visit . You'll need to login for playing with ClubDMX. I have prepared two users with different rights, details follow below.
(The Web page language is German. Contributers that translate to other languages are highly welcome.)
features: ClubDMX runs on a Raspberry PI (or on any other computer with Linux OS) and delivers a website for the user interaction. In other words, the Raspberry PI hosts the software, the user operates on his favorite device,…
The website is written in Responsive Design and adopts to the size of the screen.

The DMX connection is carried out by OLA . There is a lot of hardware options available, for example Enttec DMX USB Pro and DMX King. OLA establishes various ethernet protocols like ArtNet, sACN and others. An overview…
The first and basic goal in the development of ClubDMX was to enable an easy handling of Light Scenes (= Cues).
One Cue with top priority for direct handling the the hardware devices and creating new Cues
